description_en: Upgrades the plan configuration for a specified simple application server
description_zh: 为指定的轻量应用服务器升级套餐配置
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open upgrade-instance --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --plan-id swas.s2.c2m2s50b4t08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the specified simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the specified simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the plan to which you want to upgrade. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189314.html to query plan information
parameters.help_zh: 升级后的套餐ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189314.html查询套餐信息
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
